The Ashwardens are fewer than a village choir. They wear no uniform except a smear of ash on the left wrist, renewed whenever a hearth is tended.

They were gathered when [[The Hearth Compact]] was sworn. Their lodge looks down on [[Ember Reach]] from a rise of pale grass. Inside, [[The Last Coal]] sits in a shallow bowl and does not go out.

They asked [[Mira Vale]] for a map of the dying banks. Some of them hoped the river would be ashamed and return. Mira brought them paper instead.
